,') as d_code ,COUNT(DISTINCT substr(d.DIDSTD,1,19)) g_count ,COUNT(IF(CHK_ASA = 'Y',1,NULL )) c_asa ,COUNT(IF(AMOUNT <= 2,1,NULL )) c_stat ,0 as result FROM tmp_drug_asu d INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode=h.hoscode AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,15) INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON d.HOSPCODE=p.HOSPCODE AND d.PID=p.PID WHERE d.date_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d AND d.amount > 0 AND d.scount =1 AND SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1); SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001'); SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930'); DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS t_ht_rdu ; CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS t_ht_rdu ( PRIMARY KEY (hospcode,pid), KEY (hospcode,pid) ) ENGINE=myISAM IGNORE AS SELECT d.HOSPCODE,d.PID,d.DATE_SERV ,GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT('{"SEQ":"',d.seq ,'","DATE_SERV":"',d.date_serv,'","DIDSTD":"',d.didstd,'","DNAME":"',d.dname,'","AMOUNT":"',d.amount,'"}') ORDER BY d.date_serv SEPARATOR '
,') as d_code ,COUNT(DISTINCT substr(d.DIDSTD,1,19)) g_count ,COUNT(IF(CHK_ASA = 'Y',1,NULL )) c_asa ,COUNT(IF(AMOUNT <= 2,1,NULL )) c_stat ,0 as result FROM tmp_drug_asu d INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode=h.hoscode AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,15) INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON d.HOSPCODE=p.HOSPCODE AND d.PID=p.PID WHERE d.date_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d AND d.amount > 0 AND d.scount =1 AND (CHK_NSAID_EAT = 'Y' OR CHK_ASA = 'Y') AND SUBSTR(d.DIDSTD,17,1) IN(2,3) GROUP BY d.HOSPCODE,d.PID,d.DATE_SERV; UPDATE t_ht_rdu SET result=1 WHERE g_count >=2 ; UPDATE t_ht_rdu SET result=0 WHERE g_count=2 AND c_asa=1; UPDATE t_ht_rdu SET result=0 WHERE g_count=2 AND c_stat=1; DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx; CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx AS SELECT p.HOSPCODE,p.PID, p.CID, p.NAME, p.LNAME, p.SEX ,p.BIRTH, p.HID, p.addr, p.check_vhid, p.NATION, p.TYPEAREA ,d.DATE_SERV,d.d_code ,d. g_count ,d.c_asa ,IF(d.c_stat>=1,'พบข้อมูล',null) c_stat ,IF(d.result IN(1),'นับผลงาน','ไม่ตรงตามเกณฑ์ A') result FROM t_ht_rdu d INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON d.HOSPCODE=p.HOSPCODE AND d.PID=p.PID WHERE d.date_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d ; SELECT h.hoscode, h.hosname, d.PID, d.CID, d.NAME, d.LNAME, d.SEX , d.BIRTH, d.HID, d.addr, d.check_vhid, d.NATION, d.TYPEAREA ,d.DATE_SERV,d.d_code,d. g_count,d.c_asa,d.c_stat ,d.result FROM tx d INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode WHERE 1=1 {where}

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("t10"+"t11"+"t12"+"t01"+"t02"+"t03"+"t04"+"t05"+"t06"+"t07"+"t08"+"t09") target ,SUM("r10"+"r11"+"r12"+"r01"+"r02"+"r03"+"r04"+"r05"+"r06"+"r07"+"r08"+"r09") result ,SUM("t10"+"t11"+"t12") targetq1 ,SUM("t01"+"t02"+"t03") targetq2 ,SUM("t04"+"t05"+"t06") targetq3 ,SUM("t07"+"t08"+"t09") targetq4 ,SUM("r10"+"r11"+"r12") resultq1 ,SUM("r01"+"r02"+"r03") resultq2 ,SUM("r04"+"r05"+"r06") resultq3 ,SUM("r07"+"r08"+"r09") resultq4  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
